text:
👍The hospital is well decorated and located right in the center of Bangkok city easily noticed on the main street.

👍The reception welcomed me with hospitality.  Moreover, its parking space is provided sufficiently.

😵‍💫However, although I reached the hospital on time, it took me about an hour to wait to see the doctor with a prior appointment. Besides, when I was supposed to do 2 scanning tests on another floor, it took me a while more to wait for getting such tests.

😵‍💫The hospital has also changed contract terms with some health insurance companies which ended up with me having to pay the hospital myself and have to take all the documents to deal with the insurance company on my own afterwards.

I came to MedPark Hospital with a lumbar disc herniation that caused strong pain and limited mobility. Medical options on Samui are very much limited, so I chose MedPark in BKK for its spine team and clear treatment structure, and my case went under the care of Dr Chaiyot Thiranont.

The surgery went well. The surgical team, inpatient unit and nursing staff worked with clear organisation, and anaesthesia was handled with care. I woke up comfortably and without side effects. Recovery after the procedure moved forward without complications.

About a month later a recurrence appeared and brought pain again, which changed the direction of my recovery. During the consultation, Dr Chaiyot suggested an individual rehabilitation plan instead of another surgery and supervised every step himself. Physiotherapy continued for two months and resulted in full resolution of the herniation (an operable case), confirmed by MRI, together with significant improvement of the affected nerve.

This was my first surgery in life, and I am grateful that it was performed by such a skilled professional. I am also grateful that we avoided a second procedure, which highlights the level of expertise Dr Chaiyot brings to his work — a rare quality in general medical practice.

I received clear guidance on long-term physical activity, and I have now completed my treatment as a patient at the hospital. The outcome was successful, thanks to the structured, attentive work of Dr Chaiyot. I would like to thank him, as well as the teams from the orthopedic department, the surgical unit and the physiotherapy department, for their professional support. Thank you very much 🙏🏼

Baby delivery at this hospital was a best experience ever for me. Very professional, smooth, amazing service, great rooms and care for the mom and baby. Thank you to my doctor Assoc. Prof. Dr. Boonchai Uerpairojkit for helping me safely welcome my baby, it was so smoothly! I also love all the nurses at NICU facility and especially nurse Meow, she was amazing, great at teaching and advising!
One of the top-tier hospital in Bangkok, Thailand. Higher price come with great building design and service. Praram 4 road traffic usually jam at 5 PM.

I didn’t expect that we will have emergency stay with MedPark Hospital but truly appreciated that our experience with professional Drs & nurses here ! Everything here deserves the 5 stars . Will continue choose MedPark Hospital as long as we stay in Bangkok.

Very relaxed atmosphere, which is a good thing since it doesn’t exactly feel much like a hospital, making it a calmer environment for stressed patients! Good doctor but outpatient care fee is overpriced. The customer service is not bad. Overall, this is a high quality hospital with probably one of the best hospital environment in Thailand!

Excellent Service and Exceptional Care!
I recently delivered my baby at the hospital, and I want to express my heartfelt thanks for the wonderful care I received. A special shout-out to Nurse Pam, who went above and beyond to make me and my baby feel safe and supported. She was incredibly professional, patient, and kind—always taking the time to explain each step to me as a new mom. Her calm presence and reassuring words made such a difference during my delivery and recovery. I’m truly grateful for her dedication and compassion. Thank you, Pam, and the entire team for making this experience such a positive one!

I recently visited MedPark Hospital for my company's annual health checkup, and I couldn't be more impressed. The entire experience was exceptionally smooth and efficient. From the moment I walked in, I was greeted by staff members who were genuinely kind, attentive, and helpful. Everyone was so nice, making what could be a stressful situation much more comfortable.

What truly stood out was how fast the service was. I was seen quickly, tests were processed efficiently, and I received clear information without any unnecessary delays.

Highly recommend for anyone looking for excellent, quick, and friendly medical service.

I wanted to get one treatment package but got another. It's like buying pork and getting chicken. The medical staff was unfair, and the hospital was irresponsible and neglected this case.

This was my first visit because I thought it was a good hospital with attractive pricing packages. I called many times to inquire before deciding to go for a check-up. On the day of my visit, the hospital's management system was not so good, including the staff and nurses. I wanted to get a premarital check-up package, but because I hadn't gotten some vaccine, the doctor chose another package, which I thought covered the package I wanted because I had stated my purpose from the beginning. While I was waiting for the check-up, I asked the nurse, but she told me the doctor's chosen package cost a different price, which was only a few bahts more, so I was okay with that. However, the results I received weren't what I wanted. The doctor seemed to be twisting my arm, perhaps because I lacked medical knowledge, and she should have communicated clearly. The patient only wanted the tests she needed. It wasn't the doctor's treatment plan that required the doctor to perform other tests. The test cost almost 7k baht, but that wasn't what I wanted, so I wasted my money. What I wanted was a 5,600 baht package. In total, that's over 10K baht. If I wanted a new test, why would I have to pay the initial amount for something I didn't need? I could have spent the entire amount at a better hospital or my regular hospital, which was more cost-effective. I think the hospital is unfair, favoring medical personnel and taking advantage of patients. They are negligent in their communication. The hospital has no responsibility and even pushes the blame onto the patients. I am very disappointed with this hospital. But it's like you've already stepped in with your left foot, and now you only need to step in with your right foot to finish. If the hospital had some sympathy and felt sorry for the patients, it would have been much better.

text:
MedPark is the best-kept secret in Bangkok healthcare. This isn’t just how I feel; it is what I know.

After being diagnosed with an operable cancer, I visited several other hospitals. They all offered a 'one-way' approach that disregarded me as a patient. I was actually on the verge of simply accepting living with cancer as my only option. Then, I called MedPark. I asked for someone who spoke fluent English to help me explore my options.
I was contacted by Ganda B., a man of angelic demeanor who immediately calmed me. I then met Mark L., an action-oriented leader. Within ten minutes, they helped me navigate the first steps—a complete restart of my diagnosis with a fresh perspective. They recommended Dr. Akanae W., a master surgeon and 'magician.' Dr. Akanae truly listened and was never dismissive. He offered options, admitted the difficulty of the case, but remained hopeful. He established a clear plan and formed a team, and I followed it.
A biopsy was essential, yet every other hospital had refused to perform one. Dr. Unchala B. performed it masterfully. This was followed by liver and lymph clearance by Dr. Santi K. and Dr. Sorranut T. Focus then shifted to Dr. Kawin T., the 'kidney master,' and Dr. Sanisara C., who ensured my heart was strong enough for the journey. When surgery arrived, I was in the hands of Dr. Phuphit F., the anesthesiology lead, and Dr. Wittawat T., the assistant surgeon who ensured every detail was perfect.
I wish I could name every doctor and nurse on every floor, but I must specifically mention the nurses on the 21st-floor post-surgery recovery unit. They are God’s unknown helpers, forever known in my heart for their care. The skill of this medical team is outstanding—on par with, if not better than, any institution I have visited in the USA.

The universe gives us purpose; everyone I encountered gave me a reason to keep the chain linked. I am grateful beyond words. I received the best care from the best people. Dr. Akanae, the magician who did the impossible,is here for a purpose: to save others. You and your team saved me. I am humbly thankful. Thank you all. Now, go save the next human.🙏🏿🙏🏿🙏🏿🙏🏿🙏🏿🙏🏿

As per Mr. Kazi Sharhan Saif suggestion we visited Med Park hospital, Bangkok & got excellent services. We recommended others to visit as well as thanks for your services.
Patient name: JAHANARA MIZAN SINHA
PASSPORT: B00232923
HN: 699004321

This hospital is amazing. My son is currently staying here on ICU
Staff here are amazing, they are so so kind, caring, empathetic, thoughtful, the list goes on. It matbe expensive but worth every penny. God bless you all. ❤️

Dear MedPark Hospital Team,

We recently visited MedPark Hospital with our baby, and we would like to share our experience with you.

From the moment we arrived, the staff hospitality was excellent. Everyone was very kind, helpful, and guided us clearly to the right floor and department. We consulted the pediatric dermatologist, and the doctor was very friendly, knowledgeable, and attentive—we truly appreciate her efforts and care. The nursing team was also wonderful; they were very supportive, patient, and tried their best to comfort our baby even when she was crying a lot. Thank you so much to the doctor and nurse team for your kindness and dedication.

However, we also had one moment of disappointment during our second visit for our baby’s skin biopsy. While the doctor and nurses were again excellent, the payment process was difficult for us. After the procedure, we needed to pay and collect a prescription for waterproof dressings. At this time, our baby was very restless and crying heavily. We kindly asked the staff twice if the process could be made quicker because of our baby’s situation. Unfortunately, we were still kept waiting for quite a while, and our baby eventually cried herself to sleep before we received the prescription about 15 minutes later. This was very stressful and heartbreaking for us as parents.

We hope that in the future, the management team can review this process and consider ways to support families with young children more efficiently in such situations.

Overall, apart from this one experience, we are very happy with the care and service we received at MedPark Hospital, and we will certainly visit again. Thank you once again to the doctors, nurses, and staff for your dedication and care.

I visited for eye treatment and surgery and was admitted to the hospital. The food was surprisingly good, and the atmosphere was very calm and relaxing; it hardly feels like a hospital, which really helps reduce stress for patients. The …

We came from Saudi Arabia to Thailand for the birth of our second baby, and after considering many different hospitals, I couldn’t be happier that we chose MedPark. From start to finish, everything was beyond my expectations.

A very special thank you to Dr. Sornpin, who is truly pro-natural and supported me throughout my journey with such calmness, confidence, and care. Her expertise and presence made me feel safe and empowered every step of the way. I also want to give my heartfelt thanks to Dr. Apple, the pediatrician who looked after our newborn from the very first moments and continued to care for her during our stay. Every time we saw her she was attentive, positive, kind, and reassuring.

The hospital itself is outstanding—spotlessly clean, modern, and beautifully designed. The recovery room felt more like a hotel, with a breathtaking view that made the stay extra special. The food, the services, and the overall approach are truly top-notch.

I can honestly say that I had the best possible experience at MedPark, and I am deeply grateful for the wonderful care my baby and I received. Highly recommend!

Thank you for your management team prompt response. I appreciated your quick attention & clarification & made me feel being heard. Again, my husband & I still trust in your doctor, specialist & front line service team. In my case, both our …

I was upset with the insurance managerial system of the hospital. I took my husband to see a very great specialist here on January 10. We decided to choose your hospital  to take care of us. It got to the point that my husband needed a special skin surgery. The doctor suggested the soonest surgery, let’s say 18 January. I asked the nurse to do the pre-claim quotation from my husband’s insurance before the upcoming date.

Thus, the pre-claim results did not come until today (25 January). The surgery was postponed to be 22 January then again 29 January with the reason of no pathologists to be working on the scheduled surgery day. We were frustrated because what my husband needs to get done was somewhat serious but we needed to know the pre-claimed estimation, just like everybody else does. Otherwise, we were having to pay a large amount of money out of pocket & who knows when or will the reimburse be proceeded & done. I had looked into the actual reason of postponing.

I was upset why this big name & fancy hospital like this could not manage to get the insurance coverage results. So far, we were kept holding on for nothing for 15 days. I decided to ask around, I received the answers from other references from other insurance companies.  Turning out reference stated that Med Park is blacklisted by 3 major insurance companies. Oh I got it, that was why it delayed so I am not trusting to go ahead with the service here anymore. I decided to take my husband’s case somewhere else & will let all my friends & family not to choose the service here. I do not know why & what delayed the pre-claimed process. However, the management needs to find out & fix it.

Maybe the management could contact me & explained why we got no response.  Hope everyone who’s got more serious trouble will get the pre-claimed results sooner. To the Med Park management, I do not know what wrongdoing from whom or which department, but you need to fix this for preventing the consequences of this delay will cause a tremendous life damages & loss to your patiences.

Great hospital to get the covid vaccine. The hospital is very clean and tidy, beautiful and modern, it is a pleasure to spend time here. The only pity is that the queue for vaccination starts outside and that the waiting time is about 1 …

My sister was hospitalized and had surgery on both of her knees at Medpark Hospital under the care of Dr. Siripong Ratanachai. The doctor and nurses were very patient, kind, and professional. They took great care of me, and everything went smoothly during my stay. I am very satisfied with the service and truly appreciate the care from the entire medical team.

My experience with the maternity services at Medpark Hospital was, in a word, exceptional. For the delivery and the care provided by the surgeon of my wife, I was genuinely astounded by the level of excellence. I stayed in Ward 22 and would rate it a perfect 10 out of 10; I simply cannot find a single fault.
The extra bed I requested for 500 baht per night was incredibly comfortable—the best I've ever experienced in any hospital while staying with a patient. They even offered a selection of 7-8 different pillows, one of which was so perfect I had to take note of the brand to buy for my own home. The view from the room was stunning, and the room itself was far superior to those at other hospitals we had considered. The layout was thoughtfully designed with separate zones for visitors and the patient, which allowed two people to stay overnight comfortably without feeling cramped. The nurses and housekeeping staff were wonderful—attentive, caring, and remarkably prompt. Whenever we called for assistance, they arrived almost instantly, a stark contrast to other hospitals where we've been left waiting so long we wondered if we’d been forgotten.
When comparing the cost to other leading private hospitals, Medpark was not more expensive; in fact, it was more affordable.
However, where there is good, there is often bad. In stark contrast to the flawless maternity care, my experience with other aspects of the hospital was surprisingly poor.
From the moment we arrived, despite a clear entrance for the Emergency Room, the security guard refused us entry. This was after my wife’s water had broken, we had called ahead to notify the hospital, and the nurses had specifically instructed us to use the ER entrance. We had to negotiate with the guard just to be allowed to reverse our car and enter the proper way, as my wife needed to be lying flat and could not use a wheelchair.
Later during our stay, I tried to park on the same level as the elevator exit to make it more convenient for my wife, who had just undergone a C-section and shouldn't be walking up or down stairs. Again, a security guard stopped me. Despite the parking garage on the 2nd and 3rd floors being almost completely empty late at night, he had blocked off the spaces with cones and insisted I park on floor 3A, stating that floors 2 and 3 were reserved for "day patients." Does this mean that despite paying over half a million baht, I am only afforded the convenience of a good parking spot if I arrive during the day? What kind of system is that?
Furthermore, for other services like vaccinations or general appointments, the waiting times were inexplicably long, even when the hospital was visibly empty with very few other patients around. The same lengthy wait occurred when it was time to pay the bill. With no one else in line, I was left wondering what was causing the delay. Every visit to this hospital for non-maternity reasons has taken over two hours, despite the lack of crowds.
In summary, for the specific purpose of childbirth and C-section delivery, Medpark Hospital is absolutely outstanding—a perfect 10/10. However, when it comes to the hospital's general systems and attention to smaller details, the experience was shockingly disappointing for a leading private hospital in the country.

I had colonoscopy few days ago here.
This hospital is new, big and very organized. Service is very quick.

Staff service is the best. Admin/nurse K.kanchana explained quite clearly on preparation, tone of voice via phone call is impressive. On the test day, all nurses are very attentive, nurse k.Natcha anticipates my needs- she serve me hot coffee after recovery. Great service mind.

In regard to the preprecliner room, normal room is a bit small in my opinion. I feel not comfortable to sit here for long hour. Toilet part should have sign to remind patient to close when flush, it could help to reduce spread of bacteria. I have to open the door and stand outside from time to time.

Overall is good. Recommended!

I would like to express my dissatisfaction regarding the service my mother received today.
We had an appointment scheduled at 9:00 AM for her ongoing medical treatment and visa extension process. However, upon arrival, the Myanmar interpreter informed us to wait until 9:30 AM and suggested we go have breakfast.
When we returned at 9:30 AM, the staff member handling the visa process came and informed us that we would only be able to proceed at 11:00 AM. This repeated delay caused inconvenience and unnecessary waiting for the patient.
We feel that the service was not handled professionally, and there was a lack of proper coordination and communication.
I kindly request that you review this situation and improve your service to prevent similar issues in the future.

My wife and I had spent three great weeks in Bangkok when she started feeling head and chest congestion. We first went to an urgent care to address the issue. They requested she come back two days later for a follow up. The doctor there said her diagnosis had not improved and strongly recommended we go to MedPark Hospital for immediate treatment. We are so glad we did!

With full paperwork from the urgent care, regarding their observations and treatment, we immediately went to MedPark Hospital. Upon our arrival, the admission process was professional and expedient. My wife has spent more than 45 years as a medical office manager and made that statement immediately upon their actions. We waited a minimum amount of time before we were taken to another floor, waiting to see a doctor. Five minutes after our arrival to that waiting area, we were sitting in front of Assist.Prof.Dr Jirayos Chinatanadilok. He listened intently to everything my wife had to say, did a check of her vitals and listened to her breathing. A few minutes later, he had directed to have x-rays and a CT performed of her head and chest. It wasn't 15 minutes after they were performed that those results were on his computer with a full display for him to explain his concerns and what needed to be performed next. Within 1 to 1.5 hours, my wife was in her assigned room with an IV in her hand with treatment being applied.

Let me expound on our situation. We have an LTR visa, but were scheduled to fly back to the states since my mother had been placed in hospice. She was 96. Yes, she passed on our transit home. However, Dr. Chintanadilok knew this about my mother and approached my wife's illness with both these concerns in hand. But, first and foremost, my wife's wellbeing was his priority! I would have changed our itinerary had he recommended a longer stay at the hospital.

My wife was brought to a much better medical state within four days under this doctor's care. She wasn't 100%, but much better than her medical state upon admission and able to sustain through a lengthy flight home.

I can confirm with 100% certainty that had we gone to an ER in near our home's local with her condition, she would have been treated and sent home as an outpatient with no oversight. We have been  home since January 8th here in North Carolina. Since we have been with the same GP for 20+ years, he saw her immediately and did an x-ray. From his view of that, we also have an appointment with a network pulmonologist and will wait to see his diagnosis.

Although we were impressed by MedPark Hospital's initial presentation, we know that anything can be made to look shiny and great. My wife's medical management from admission to release by the staff at MedPark was above reproach. Everything we encountered was exceptionally professional. Again, my wife had been in the business for 45+ years. So, her evaluation has merit.

I will end this review, what may seem to some to be a thesis, by saying the room she was in was absolutely 5⭐️, as was the nursing staff, and the administration/billing employees we encountered. They were absolutely professional in their handling of my wife's wellbeing and hospital stay.
What was incredible to us was after the individual from billing finished his "in room" visit, a full, comprehensive folder of my wife's diagnosis and treatment by Dr. Chintanadilok, with a complete breakdown of the precise billing(which we required for TriCare Overseas), and a disc of the x-rays and CT scans was provided. My wife has had other major surgeries, we never saw anything like this immediately, if at all, upon her release.

We are coming back to Thailand and plan on using our LTR Visas as expatriates in Bangkok. We plan on finding a condo near MedPark Hospital and using their expertise for all our future medical needs! Also, upon our return, we plan on my wife having a follow-up visit with Dr. Chintanadilok for his oversight of her pulmonology health as long as we live there.

Awesome Staff and Hospital! Just Phenomenal!

text:
Positive experience at MedPark Hospital with excellent medical care and good quality rooms, cleanliness, and food.

Special mention to the Bangladesh interpreter team for proactively checking in on us, helping solve problems and facilitating our communication with the hospital very well.

Also special mention to Patient Care staff for typing up summaries of ongoing treatment and medication plan during admission for Patient’s family.

The hospital is less than 2 years old, but many of the medical staff and support staff have years of experience.

The hospital is clean, accessible, workers are their to help, and there is transparency in their work. Great for checkups, disease management and other services. This will help the competitive market in Bangkok.

I’ve never seen a better hospital and have never received better, the most thorough, care and service.
From the nurses to the billing, the amazing doctors and the visa assistance it’s a 100/10. No one says this about hospitals, but I wanted to move in!
I along with my family was visited Medpark Hospital, due to my kids sudden illness of diarrhoea. Their instant support and treatment was excellent. We wish every success to them.
Nice modern hospital that feels more like a hotel and office but has terrible lift system. …

Med Park Hospital is an exceptional healthcare facility that provides an unparalleled level of service and care to patients. Having resided in Bangkok for two years, I had the opportunity to visit several other hospitals, including …

It is new and clean and very quick to see doctors as it is not crowded.  However, the doctors here are not as good as the more established hospitals.  The doctors here tend to be older and probably retired from somewhere else.

The treatment here is also more expensive than other hospitals.
I only come here for easy ailments or when I need to be in and out quickly.

Without a doubt the best hospital I have been at, very modern, great staff from doctor to concierge. Recommend for expats or tourists as English was no issue and they had someone ready to help in just minutes.

Lots of advanced equipment and well known physicians. Very premium hospital. Quite empty as just opened Oct 2020. Lots of parking. Enter on Rama 4 road. Beautiful rooms, get the river view of you can, unless you like the park views.
Incredible experience! I came for the comprehensive male health screening. I paid out of pocket — and it was approximately 25k baht, plus some extra for the non-included tests. …

🌟 Warm & Appreciative Review

Dr. Suwatchai at MedPark Hospital, Bangkok performed my angiogram, and I am …

Overpriced compared to Bumrungrad or Samitijevi for blood test, medicine and hospital fee. The doctor did not explain the reason of my health issue in details even due I asked different question. She looked more just interested in prescribe me extra expensive medicine and more tests.
I needed to receive another rabies shot. The hospital is fantastic, really clean and modern. Everyone  was very kind and friendly. Thank you, MedPark team!

Did a sleep test here and stayed for a night. All the staffs are very professional and caring. The room was comfortable and had everything you need. I myself also worked in healthcare and really appreciate the high standards of practice here.

Hospital food was surprisingly very nice. I got boiled rice with seabass soup which was delicious. You can also order other meals from the restaurants in the hospital (Coco Ichibanya / Seefah)

Highly recommended.

We had an exceptional experience during our stay at the hospital. The medical staff, particularly the doctors, were outstanding, ensuring my labor was both smooth and pleasant.

Our son was born preterm and required intensive care in the NICU. What could have been a very stressful experience was made significantly easier by the highly attentive and caring nurses and doctors. We are especially thankful for P'Rung, a nurse in the NICU, who provided us with invaluable advice and outstanding care for both our son and me post-delivery. She taught us crucial skills for first-time parents, including how to care for and monitor our baby, as well as breastfeeding techniques. This truly made our transition into parenthood seamless. We sincerely appreciate the five-star service and would highly recommend this hospital.
Great environment in the pediatric department! They have a well-designed kids’ zone with separate areas for sick and healthy children, very thoughtful and safe for everyone.
A useless hospital that just wants to take your money if you're looking for a decent clinic and treatment. You're better off going to another hospital. …

Brand new 5-Star hospital located on Rama4 near Sirikit Conventional Center. Leading doctors in all fields await to treat patients with capable staff and excellent modern facilities. Ample and free parking. Easy access with various options …

New and clean hospital. All kinds of vaccination available (TBH 1,650) for even foreigners. The registration process very simple and vaccination completed in 30min. Credit card acceptable. Certification ready for international flight.

This is new and clean hospital.
There are Japanese desk at ground floor.
Translator, エアー san was very kind.
He supported totally. Dr. Jamigorn was also kind.

In addition, entrance staff gave me a chair while I was waiting a car.

Thank you for all staff!!

Went to this place to the launching of the new healthy trendy 5 stars restaurant, " Greyhound cafe MedPark". A beautiful restaurant with healthy good food and also most popular foods from Greyhound recipes. Open from 7.00 a.m. - 7.00 p.m. at G fl. MedPark hospital.

Long story short...
* Admitted for vertigo but received no treatment, had to request medication myself.
* Admitted because I was suppose to see a neurologist, but she did not turn up till the second day because my attending did not notify her until the next day.
* IV into a wrong vein and they injected saline even though it caused me much pain. I complained before they injected the saline that the needle caused me pain but the nurse said it was normal! Ps. Most of the other staff were very nice, helpful and took a very good care of me.

I would like to express my sincere gratitude to Dr. Wirach Jitsutthiphakorn for accurately diagnosing my condition and for providing excellent care and advice. I am very happy and impressed. 10/10 experience at a more than reasonable price for a private hospital.

UPDATE:

I would like to update my review following further communication with MedPark Hospital.

After my original review was posted, the hospital’s management team reached out to me directly to discuss my concerns. They acknowledged that there should have been better transparency regarding the doctor’s consultation fee and took the matter seriously. Following their internal review, they agreed to refund the doctor’s consultation fee, which I appreciate.

I also want to recognize that MedPark did not simply dismiss the complaint. The management team listened to my feedback, investigated the matter, and worked towards a resolution.

For context, my concern was never about receiving poor medical care. Medpark provides top class medical care in Thailand. The issue was specifically related to fee transparency and the lack of prior disclosure regarding a significantly higher consultation fee.

While I still believe patients should be informed in advance when there are substantial differences in doctors’ consultation fees, I appreciate the hospital’s willingness to review the situation and address the concern after it was brought to their attention.

Overall, this experience showed that MedPark values patient feedback and is willing to take corrective action when issues arise.

ORIGINAL REVIEW:
Our family has been loyal MedPark Hospital patients since the hospital first opened. Both of our sons were born here, have received all of their vaccinations here, and continue to visit the pediatric and dental departments regularly. My wife and I also use MedPark as our primary hospital.

This is why we were particularly disappointed by a recent experience at the Internal Medicine Department.

My wife visited for what turned out to be a common cold and had a consultation lasting approximately five minutes. We were subsequently charged a doctor consultation fee of THB 2,200. Over many years of visits to various departments and specialists at MedPark, we have typically encountered consultation fees in the THB 900–1,200 range, so this charge came as a surprise.

Our concern is not simply the amount charged, but the lack of transparency. We were not informed in advance that the consultation fee would be THB 2,200. Had we been informed beforehand, we would likely have chosen a different doctor. Patients should be given the opportunity to make informed decisions when there are significant differences in consultation fees.

After we raised the issue, a duty manager contacted us and said the matter would be investigated and that we would receive a callback the following day. Unfortunately, no one ever followed up as promised.

We have trusted MedPark Hospital with our family’s healthcare for many years, including the births and ongoing care of our children. The medical care has generally been good, but this experience left us disappointed with both the lack of fee transparency and the failure to follow through on a promised response. We will not be visiting Medpark again.

I hope MedPark will improve communication regarding consultation fees and ensure that patient concerns are properly followed up.

My family & I would like to express our sincere gratitude to MedPark Hospital for the exceptional care my Mom received.

My Mom had been suffering from severe stomach pain & was hospitalized in Myanmar, but her condition didn’t improve despite several examinations & treatments. As her pain became unbearable, we decided to seek treatment at MedPark Hospital in Bangkok.

From the moment we arrived, everything was handled professionally & efficiently. The medical team quickly conducted comprehensive examinations & identified the cause of her illness. We are especially grateful to Dr. Santi Kulpatcharapong and Dr. Jirayos Chintanadilok for their expertise, dedication, & compassionate care. Thanks to their thorough investigations & treatment, my Mom’s condition improved dramatically within days.

Throughout our stay, the nurses, junior doctors, & Myanmar Team provided outstanding support. The Myanmar Team was also incredibly helpful, assisting us with communication & even offering support regarding visa extensions when needed. My Mom is very anxious about medical procedures, but everyone treated her with patience, kindness, and reassurance, helping her feel comfortable and cared for during a difficult time.

What impressed us most was the hospital’s commitment to finding the true cause of my mother’s illness & prioritizing patient care above everything else. The hospital was also clean, well-organized, & welcoming, creating a comfortable environment for both patients & their families.

The care & service we received were truly worth it because my Mom received the correct diagnosis, effective treatment, & made a remarkable recovery.

Thank you to Dr. Santi Kulpatcharapong, and Dr. Jirayos Chintanadilok, & the entire MedPark team for helping my Mom recover. We will always be grateful for the excellent care & support we received. 🙏

Don't think that just because you're admitted you'll get to sleep. The rooms aren't soundproof at all. You can hear the people in the next room closing their doors every time. Staff members put things down loudly, housekeepers slam the refrigerator doors shut while getting food, everyone is chattering nonstop. It's incredibly annoying. If I have to stay here because I'm sick, I'd rather die than suffer this much.

I went to see the doctor because of a lump on my arm. We were quite concerned, especially since I'm young. The doctor sent me for imaging, and by the time I came back, the doctor had already gone in for surgery. We understand that, as they are also doctors, and that the main responsibility of an orthopedic doctor is surgery. However, the hospital said they would call with the results within 24 hours, but there was no contact. They only sent an email with the imaging results. What we need is a plan for further testing and future treatment. After calling to follow up, we were told to wait another 24 hours, but still no information. Because we are very worried, we specifically came to see a specialist, expecting quick treatment in a private setting. However, it feels like the hospital isn't following up on the case.

I brought my child in for an evaluation of chronic constipation, which has been ongoing for quite some time. As we had not seen a doctor for a while, there was a lot of information to share, and it was not presented in a perfectly structured order—which is quite normal for parents.

During the consultation, the doctor interrupted several times and appeared irritated, stating that the information provided was “confusing,” rather than helping to guide the conversation by asking questions to identify the key points. This created a tense atmosphere and made me feel that I was not being properly listened to.

From my past experiences with other doctors, most understand that parents may not present information in a perfectly organized way and usually help extract the relevant details.
The service you only can get  is cashier, the price is higher than the value and not transparent, please carefully select this hospital as your health keeper.
